identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of IBI363 in Subjects with Advanced Solid Malignancies
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Open-label, Multicenter Study of IBI363 (PD1-IL2m) in Subjects with Advanced Solid Malignancies

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase 2, open-label, multicenter study designed to evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of IBI363 (study drug) in subjects with advanced, refractory solid malignancies.

armGroups.label: IBI363
armGroups.description: IBI363 will be administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion every 2 weeks or every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: IBI363
interventions.description: IBI363 will be administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion every 2 weeks or every 3 weeks. Subjects will receive study medication until disease progression, toxicity intolerance, withdrawal of consent, the duration of treatment reaches 24 months, or any other reason that requires discontinuation of the study treatment, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 90 days post last dose

The DLT observation period is 35 days starting from the first day of cycle 1 (C1D1) for subjects assigned to 1000 μg/kg Q2W, while 28 days starting from the C1D1 for subjects assigned to 2000/3000/4000 μg/kg Q3W.
